title: Identity & Access Modernization
breadcrumb: Services > Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust > Identity & Access Modernization
meta_description: Identity & Access Modernization from Dataq Software: scope, delivery pattern, platforms and committed outcomes.

blocks.x: The honest pitch for identity & access modernization fits in a sentence — Identity as the perimeter — workforce, customer and machine identities on one governed plane. — and the rest of this page is the how: measured baseline, bounded build, evidence in flight.
What we deliver under this name

Identity programs drown in scope: workforce access, customer IAM (CIAM), and the machine identities that now outnumber humans ten to one. We modernize all three on governed planes — workforce IAM with lifecycle driven by HR events (joiner-mover-leaver automation), CIAM with consent, step-up authentication and fraud signals, and machine identity management for service accounts, certificates and workload identities with rotation and attestation.

The compliance dividend is immediate: access reviews that take weeks become continuous entitlement analytics; certification evidence exports directly; orphaned accounts surface within hours of the triggering event. We include the migration psychology — phased cutover, helpdesk surge support and communication plans — because failed logins are how good security programs die politically.

Programs of Identity & Access Modernization run in Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Retail & Consumer Goods — always against one named number, always with the baseline signed first.
